description: ETHOS.BUILDA: Building Footprint and Height Dataset Germany is published by Dabrock, Kristina; Pflugradt, Noah; Weinand, Jann Michael; Stolten, Detlef. It describes German building footprints and heights with per-attribute source and processing lineage, distributed as CSV with WKT geometry. Coverage is national within DE. Spatial detail: Building polygons; EPSG:3035. The data period and sampling interval are not fully established. Access is through the public metadata page and its provider links. The metadata lists CSV, WKT; these files were not downloaded. Licence: ODbL database; component contents retain source-specific licences. The public page or repository can be read without payment; this does not establish free access to every linked artefact. The Jülich entry is a pointer with a CC0 metadata label. The actual Zenodo dataset specifies ODbL and source-specific content rights; the metadata label must not be applied to the data. This review identifies capacity planning, climate adaptation as potential simulation uses, subject to the stated limits. Related catalogue records are model-energyplus. These are contextual links; no unverified interoperability or actual use is claimed.
